description: Find the words an essay uses most, to spot overused or repeated terms. Inputs: text, and optional top (how many words to list, default 10), min_count (fewest uses for a word to be listed, default 2) and include_common_words (also count small words such as the, and, of and to, default false).     Case is ignored, and words under 3 letters are skipped unless include_common_words is true. Each word comes with its count and its share of all the words in the text. Example: "Which words do I overuse in this essay?.

include_common_words.description: Also count small common words. Default false.

min_count.description: Fewest uses for a word to be listed. Default 2.

top.description: How many words to list. Default 10.

name: word_frequency
title: Word frequency
